OC-D5.who: 89, male, white, registered Republican, homeowner, Irvine South
OC-D5.voice: I am an 89-year-old registered Republican homeowner in Irvine South, retired, and I still vote all the way down the ballot because county supervisor races affect property taxes and how my money gets spent. Party registration is my strong default on a partisan-flavored seat like this. What seals it is that Dixon reads as the reasonable, fiscally-conservative type of Republican, not a culture warrior. CA-Gov.scenario: A major wildfire dominates statewide news in the final week and the sitting administration is visible managing the response. The same agents vote again.

CA-11.voice: Pelosi's open seat, and both finalists are progressive Democrats, so I am not picking a party, I am picking a flavor. Wiener is the build-more-housing YIMBY, Chan is the tenant-and-neighborhood left. I agree with both of them most of the time, which is exactly why this is hard.

CA-11.scenario: A late housing-and-cost-of-living story dominates the local race and sharpens the YIMBY-vs-tenant contrast. The same agents vote again.
CA-11.delta: +3pp to Wiener. Same-party, so the move is turnout geography. N=12, illustrative.
